newsitem.title: USA: Genus Inc names Bobel CFO.
newsitem.headline: Genus Inc names Bobel CFO.

text.p: Genus Inc, a supplier of semiconductor capital equipment, on Monday said it has named Mary Bobel as its new chief financial officer, replacing Ernest Quinones.
Quinones had been named acting CFO in May last year to replace Kent Robertson, who resigned to take a similar position at another company.
Bobel, 47, was most recently chief financial officer at Mountain View, Calif.-based Educational Publishing Corp.

"Mary will develop and oversee the implementation of financial programs that can support our dynamic growth objectives, including the introduction of new equipment financing options for our customers," James Healy, chief executive, said in a statement.

Bobel's experience includes Advanced Micro Devices Inc and five years at Adobe Systems Inc, where she held positions ranging from director of financial planning to vice president and corporate controller.
